name: Technical Design Report for the ATLAS Inner Tracker Strip Detector

summary.plain: The plan for the all-silicon strip tracker that will surround the ITk pixel detector for the high-luminosity LHC.
summary.technical: ATLAS ITk Strip TDR (CERN-LHCC-2017-005, ATLAS-TDR-025, 1 Apr 2017): design of the Phase-II Inner Tracker strip system replacing the current SCT and TRT for HL-LHC running.
